title: How Damon Chen built IndieLog: a video-first indie hacker community born from his own loneliness
summary: Damon Chen explains how he built IndieLog (a vlog community for indie hackers) to solve his own remote-work isolation, and how a launch on Indie Hackers then Product Hunt plus daily presence seeded it. He also covers features designed to drive member activity and his plan to add gamification.

principles.text: Build products from a problem you personally have; the idea came from his own isolation while working from home.
principles.quote: the idea was coming from my own problem. Starting from this March, I began to work from home because of the lockdown.

principles.text: Differentiate by being more human than existing options instead of cloning another text forum.
principles.quote: I don’t want to create another one. I want to create something a little more human where people can have more personalized interactions.

principles.text: Launch in the community where your target users already gather; the Indie Hackers launch produced uploads within a day.
principles.quote: I launched indielog on Indiehackers community, one day later, I got several new video uploads.

principles.text: Follow the community launch with Product Hunt for extra traffic, then stay consistent and active rather than over-promoting.
principles.quote: After that, I didn’t do too much promotion, but I try to be consistent to update my work on Indielog almost every day and be very active to interact with other members in our community.

principles.text: Ship features whose common goal is to drive member contribution (topics lower the blank-page barrier, products tie updates to progress).
principles.quote: The common goal of all these things is to motivate members to do more video updates.

principles.text: A small community can be a feature, not a flaw, when closeness is the value.
principles.quote: we are still very small, we have less than 200 members, but to me, it’s good to be small as well. It like a friend circle I created all around the world.
